LUXEMBOURG


, Sept. 25, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A.** will host its Third Quarter 2026 earnings call on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


A results release will be posted to our website at midday BST (07:00 EDT) on October 22, 2026, at[https://ir.ardaghmetalpackaging.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4783137-1&h=272532976&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ardaghmetalpackaging.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.ardaghmetalpackaging.com%2F)


An investor webcast and conference call will be held at 14:00 BST (09:00 EDT) on October 22, 2026. A full replay of the presentation will also be available at the same link shortly after the conclusion of the live presentation.

**About Ardagh Metal Packaging**
Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) is a leading global supplier of sustainable and infinitely recyclable metal beverage cans to brand owners globally. An operating business of sustainable packaging business Ardagh Group, AMP is a leading industry player across Europe and the Americas with innovative production capabilities. AMP operates 23 production facilities in nine countries, employing approximately 6,500 people with sales of $5.5bn in 2025.
